title: Redux DevTools
description: Learn how to debug Redux applications with DevTools.

data.text: **Redux DevTools** is a browser extension that provides powerful debugging capabilities for Redux applications. It lets you inspect every action, see state diffs, jump back and forth in time, and replay bugs. It is one of the biggest reasons teams choose Redux for non-trivial applications.

data.title: Install the Extension
data.text: Download the Redux DevTools browser extension for Chrome or Firefox. Once installed, it will automatically connect to any Redux app that has DevTools enabled in development.

data.title: Key Features
items: **Action log**: See every action dispatched, with timestamps and payloads
**State diff**: View exactly what changed in the state after each action
**Time-travel**: Jump to any previous state by clicking an action
**Replay**: Replay a sequence of actions to reproduce a bug
**Export/Import**: Save and load state snapshots to share with teammates
**Action skipping**: Skip an action to see how the app would behave without it

data.text: When you use `configureStore` from Redux Toolkit, DevTools is enabled by default in development. You can customize the behavior, including turning it on or off based on the environment.

data.caption: How time-travel debugging works
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Dev as Developer
    participant DT as DevTools
    participant Store
    Dev->>DT: Click an old action
    DT->>Store: Replace current state with snapshot
    Store-->>Dev: UI re-renders with past state
    Dev->>DT: Click forward
    DT->>Store: Apply skipped actions
    Store-->>Dev: UI shows updated state

data.title: Time Travel
data.text: Click any action in the DevTools timeline to 'time travel' to that point in state history. The UI updates instantly to show what the user would have seen. This is invaluable for debugging complex state transitions.

terms.definition: The ability to move forward and backward through the state history to inspect how the app looked at any point in time.
A chronological list of every action dispatched in a session, with payloads and timestamps.
A captured copy of the state at a specific moment, which can be saved, shared, and reloaded.
A function that wraps the store to add extra capabilities. The DevTools extension is composed as an enhancer.

data.title: Debug with DevTools
data.description: Install Redux DevTools, run a small counter app, and use time-travel to investigate a bug.
steps: Install the Redux DevTools browser extension
Run a counter app built with configureStore
Increment the counter five times, then decrement twice
Open DevTools and inspect the action log and state diffs
Click on the third increment to time-travel back, then click forward to replay
Export the state and import it into a fresh page to see the restored state
data.expectedOutcome: You can confidently navigate the DevTools UI, time-travel between states, and use action diffs to understand exactly what your app is doing.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Redux DevTools is a browser extension for debugging Redux apps
It provides an action log, state diffs, and time-travel debugging
configureStore enables DevTools by default in development
Always disable DevTools in production for performance
Time-travel debugging is the killer feature for complex state bugs
data.takeaway: Redux DevTools turns state debugging from guesswork into a visual, time-travelable inspection of every action.
